description: Golden vectors for the deterministic motion job id (contracts/README.md, 'Deterministic job id'). Every implementation (worker: motion_worker/contract.py, Studio: spotlight/motion) must reproduce each job_id from its inputs, and each canonical string from the rules. image_sha256 = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the uploaded image blob; here the 'image' is the ASCII text in image_bytes_ascii.
algorithm: job_id = 'mj_' + sha256(utf8(canonical))[:24 hex chars]; canonical = '|'.join([model, revision, esc(prompt), esc(negative_prompt), str(width), str(height), str(num_frames), str(fps), str(steps), format(guidance_scale, '.6g'), str(seed), image_sha256]); esc(s) = s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('|', '\\|')
